sentences.en: He wore his team's arm badge with pride.
sentences.zh: 他骄傲地佩戴着队徽臂章。

sentences.en: The police officer had an identification arm badge on her uniform.
sentences.zh: 那位警察在制服上戴着身份识别臂章。

sentences.en: She earned the right to wear the new arm badge after completing her training.
sentences.zh: 她完成训练后获得了佩戴新臂章的权利。
